company.name: Department of Computer Science, University of Oxford

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Redesigned the PDQ web app and deployed it onto Oxford webservers: http://pdq-webapp.cs.ox.ac.uk/react-ui/

company.name: Department of Computer Science, University of Oxford

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Held evening help sessions for COSC-111 (Introduction to Computer Science I)

positions.title: QuaRCS Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built fully automated QuaRCS dataset collection, analysis, and reporting system with Qualtrics, Google, and Slack APIs. Developed Flask Applications to simplify admin interactions with Qualtrics-hosted QuaRCS datasets. Restructured and documented existing code for maintainability.

positions.title: Visiting Researcher
positions.description:
Developed a full-stack web application for Professor Michael Benedikt's Proof-Driven Query Planning (PDQ) project. Implemented a REST API supported by existing PDQ application architectures. Front end facilitated selecting a database schema, writing/selecting an SQL query, and generating, running, and exporting optimal query-plans.
It leverages React and Spring Boot and it's open source.

company.name: Department of Computer Science, University of Oxford

positions.title: Physics Teaching Assistant
positions.description: TAed for PHYS-116 (Introductory Mechanics) and PHYS-124 (Introductory Electromagnetism and Optics). Held weekly help sessions for PHYS-117 (Introductory Electromagnetism and Optics).

positions.title: Physics Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Designed and built a precise bidirectional current control system for delicate magnetic field manipulation in a Bose-Einstein Condensate machine. Formed topological excitations in the F=1 ground state of Rubidium 87 condensates using the aforementioned current control system.

positions.title: Curatorial Intern
positions.description: Worked with Mead Art Museum Curator Vanja Malloy on Dimensionism: Modern Art in the Age of Einstein. Researched and wrote labels for over twenty works shown at the exhibition, which opened both at the Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive and at the Mead Art Museum.

projects.title: AI Melts ICE
projects.description:
AI Melts ICE documents and predicts county-specific ICE arrests in the US.
The predictions are generated by an LSTM neural network trained on data (2014 - 2018) from Syracuse's TRAC web API.
It was made with React, Flask, and Keras and it's open source: https://github.com/camilodoa/ai-melts-ice

projects.title: Dra
projects.description: Dra is a deep learning agent that lives in your browser. Over time, it learns to approach the concentric circles in the center of the page with the help of a neural network.
